gnv_001: You can recognise it by its narrow, deeply slashed leaves, closer to fern fronds than an ordinary beech's broad oval leaf. It stands in the courtyard of Palazzo Doria-Tursi, Via Garibaldi.
gnv_002: You can recognise it by its dark, hard, evergreen leaves, looking the same in January as in July. It stands on Via Mogadiscio in Montesignano, near the church of San Michele Arcangelo.
gnv_005: You can recognise it by its soft, fibrous bark, one of four monumental trees standing within about sixty metres of each other. It stands in the Parco Storico di Villa Serra, Sant'Olcese.
